catalog.helper: Use the category view below or press Command + K to jump to a component directly.

quick_start.title: Set up first
quick_start.desc: If the package is not installed yet, start from the quick-start guide before browsing deeper.

introduction.title: Understand the layers
introduction.desc: Learn the headless and UI split first so component choices stay intentional.

theming.title: Review theming early
theming.desc: If styling and slot overrides matter, the theming guide saves time before implementation.

featured.input: A reliable base for plain text entry and more complex form composition.
featured.select: A high-frequency choice for filtering, picking, and structured input flows.
featured.dialog: The core overlay for confirmations, editing, and interruptive flows.
featured.table: A key surface for dense data reading, comparison, and structured display.

home.title: SoybeanUI
home.description: A powerful, elegant Vue 3 component system with headless primitives and ready-to-use styled wrappers.

headless_first.title: Headless First
headless_first.desc: {'@'}soybeanjs/headless focuses on state, behavior, and accessibility semantics without shipping any visual styling.

styled_wrappers.title: Styled Wrappers
styled_wrappers.desc: {'@'}soybeanjs/ui ships S-prefixed styled components so common product surfaces can be delivered without rebuilding presentation from scratch.

accessible.title: Accessibility Built In
accessible.desc: Follows WAI-ARIA patterns with keyboard navigation, focus management, and semantic state handling included.

type_safe.title: Type-safe APIs
type_safe.desc: Built with TypeScript so components, slots, and configuration surfaces stay explicit during implementation.

slot_overrides.title: Slot-level Overrides
slot_overrides.desc: Override local styling precisely through ui slot maps instead of rewriting entire components.

theme_ready.title: Theme-ready Variants
theme_ready.desc: Variants are organized with UnoCSS and {'@'}soybeanjs/cva so design tokens and themes stay scalable.

component_coverage.title: Broad Component Coverage
component_coverage.desc: Covers general UI, forms, navigation, overlays, and data display for the screens teams build most often.

ecosystem.title: Vue Ecosystem Friendly
ecosystem.desc: Works smoothly with Nuxt, auto-import workflows, and living examples that shorten adoption time.

get_started.title: Quick Setup
get_started.desc: Install the package, wire the styling layer, and get the first screen rendering end to end.

introduction.title: Understand the Split
introduction.desc: Review how the unstyled headless layer and the styled UI layer divide responsibility before choosing an integration strategy.

components.title: Browse the Catalog
components.desc: Narrow the component choice set quickly by scanning primitives, patterns, and utilities by category.

theming.title: Configure Theming
theming.desc: Learn how tokens, variants, and ui slot overrides work together before deeper customization.

two_modes.title: Two Ways to Use SoybeanUI
two_modes.description: Choose the distribution mode that fits your workflow — npm package for quick integration, or CLI copy-paste for full source control.

npm.title: NPM Package
npm.subtitle: Traditional dependency
npm.description: Install {'@'}soybeanjs/ui as a dependency. Auto-import, tree-shaking, and seamless updates via your package manager.
npm.feature_2: Tree-shaking — only bundle what you use

cli.title: CLI · Copy-Paste
cli.subtitle: shadcn-style
cli.description: Copy source code into your project with sbean CLI. Full control, full customization — you own the code.
cli.feature_0: Components live in your source tree
cli.feature_2: sbean diff to review upstream changes
cli.feature_3: Only the components you add exist

featured.title: High-signal Components
featured.desc: If you want to feel the system quickly, these components show the most representative interaction surfaces.

featured.button: A foundational entry point for actions, state transitions, and forward motion in a flow.
featured.input: A reliable starting point for entry, search, and richer form composition.
featured.select: Covers filtering, mapping, and structured option selection in frequent product scenarios.
featured.dialog: A core overlay capability for confirmations, editing flows, and interruptive tasks.
featured.table: A key component for dense data reading, comparison, and structured presentation.
featured.form: Aligns field composition, validation, and submission feedback inside one workflow.
